public_rationale: The claim turns on a 'reliable version of the product', which Marcus does not define. In his view it does not yet exist, so its costs and prices cannot be observed. 'More than customers want to pay' also has no threshold. The data for current products points both ways: flat-rate plans were underpriced for heavy agent use, yet Anthropic reported an 85% gross margin on its products in the first half of 2026. Neither tests his specific claim about a reliable product. So it cannot be scored.
limitations: The gross margin figure covers current products, not the hypothetical reliable product.
The margin figure comes from press coverage of the S-1, not the filing itself.
